plain: A false idea that misleads the mind.

webster.text: The act of deluding; deception; a misleading of the mind.

more.text: False representation; illusion; error or mistake proceeding from false views.

example.quote: When occasions present themselves, in which the interests of the people are at variance with their inclinations, it is the duty of the persons whom they have appointed to be the guardians of those interests, to withstand the temporary delusion, in order to give them time and opportunity for more cool and sedate reflection.
